Definition: Joktheel, the name of a place in Palestine, and of one in Idumaea
BiblicalUsage: Joktheel = "the blessedness of God"; 1) a city in the low country of Judah named next to Lachish; 2) the name given to the cliff which was the stronghold of Edom by king Amaziah after capturing it; also called 'Selah' and 'Petra'
